## Change

Describe the implementation change or approved article. Include the anticipated
article URL and London publication time where applicable.

## Approved copy

State the source of the owner's publication instruction. List any substantive
proposed edits. Do not put private drafts, source notes, or personal data in a
public PR; a draft flag does not make Git source private.

## Evidence

Record actual commands/results and include only public-safe review evidence.
Do not claim deployed verification before a deployment has completed.

## Release

State required human approval/merge steps and the launch gate. Cloud-agent PRs
require human review/merge. Do not bypass protections to publish.
